# Prop

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

A box to grab made by PlayerSpawn; the viewer gives it a model (PlayerModels).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `glm::vec4` | RGBA of its model |

## Notes

With a Transform (scale = size) and a dynamic box RigidBody.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: PlayerModels. Written by: PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PlayerModels](../systems/PlayerModels.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | color |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init | `props` boxes, coloured (the fourth of each four grey and heavy) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[PlayerModels](../systems/PlayerModels.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
